description: Use when unsure of an airport or city code before searching. Matches a place name or code and returns the code to pass as origin or destination, whether it is one airport or all airports in a city, and the airports a city code covers. Not needed for well-known codes like JFK or LHR.

query.description: A city or airport name, or a code to check.
query.title: Query

name: find_places

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

note.description: How to use the code, or no-match hint

places.description: Items: code, name, kind, country, plus airports[] (city) or city (airport)

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

title: Find airport and city codes
